# Watchlist brief: 2026-09-30

*Sample data for the test environment: prices and news are simulated.*

## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 rose 1.30% (z-score 1.7). Strongest sector: Communication Services (XLC) +2.35%; weakest: Materials (XLB) +0.71%. Unusual sector moves: Communication Services +2.35% (z-score 2.4), Consumer Staples +1.93% (z-score 2.1).

## Notable moves

### AAPL: -4.71% (z-score -2.24, volume 1.77x normal)
- **What happened:** AAPL moved -4.71% on volume 1.77x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** AAPL fell 4.71%; its sector (Technology, XLK) rose 1.25% and the S&P 500 rose 1.30%. That is 5.95 points worse than its sector, an unusual gap for AAPL (z-score -4.5), so the move looks specific to AAPL.
- **Likely why:** An analyst downgrade weighed on the shares. [Sample Wire](https://news.example.com/2026-09-30/aapl-news)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet

MSFT (-0.37%), NVDA (+0.08%), AMZN (+1.03%), JPM (+1.99%)

## Coming up

- Wed Sep 30: NVIDIA (NVDA): Court hearing in patent case
- Mon Oct 5: Apple (AAPL): Product launch event
